stories.title: UK Recycled-Content Packaging Up 17% Since Plastic Packaging Tax Began
stories.summary: HMRC data shows plastic packaging meeting the 30% recycled-content threshold was 17% higher in 2025–26 (1.506m tonnes) than in the first year of the Plastic Packaging Tax (2022–23). Taxable (non-compliant) plastic packaging has fallen by 21% over the same period.

stories.title: Visa Applications Fall Sharply — Monthly Entry Clearance Stats: August 2026
stories.summary: The Home Office published monthly visa statistics to August 2026. Health and Care Worker visas are down 65% year-on-year (7,600 applications) and Skilled Worker visas down 43% (26,900), continuing a steep decline driven by policy changes in July 2025. Student visa applications fell 16% year-on-year.

stories.title: Updated Immigration and Nationality Fees to Take Effect 8 October 2026
stories.summary: The Home Office has published updated visa and immigration fee tables, with new rates effective from 8 October 2026 across a range of visa and nationality services.

stories.title: Asset Recovery Statistics: Financial Years Ending 2021–2026 Published
stories.summary: The Home Office released pre-release access statistics covering asset recovery across England, Northern Ireland, and Wales, spanning five financial years through 2025/26.

stories.title: FCDO Condemns Houthis for Resuming Conflict in Yemen
stories.summary: The UK strongly condemned the Houthis' decision to resume conflict in Yemen and their attacks on Saudi Arabia, including targeting civilian and energy infrastructure. The FCDO called on the Houthis to cease attacks immediately and affirmed Saudi Arabia and Yemen's right to defend their sovereignty under international law.

stories.title: Lindy Cameron Appointed as First Female Permanent Under-Secretary at FCDO
stories.summary: The Cabinet Secretary has announced that Lindy Cameron — currently British High Commissioner to India and former CEO of the National Cyber Security Centre — will become the new Permanent Under-Secretary at the FCDO. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband welcomed her as the first female PUS in the department's history.

stories.title: Connect to Work Statistics Published: April 2025 to June 2026
stories.summary: DWP has released its first quarterly official statistics on Connect to Work — the government's employment support programme — covering referrals, starts, first earnings and job outcomes from April 2025 to June 2026.

stories.title: Work Capability Assessment Handbook Updated for Healthcare Professionals
stories.summary: DWP has published an updated version of the Work Capability Assessment handbook for healthcare professionals, providing refreshed guidance for those conducting assessments on behalf of the department.

stories.title: Proposal to Extend Surrey Hills National Landscape by 30.5% Submitted
stories.summary: Natural England has submitted a formal proposal to the Secretary of State for Environment to extend the Surrey Hills Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty by 129km², increasing its size by 30.5%. The proposal follows years of technical assessment and public consultation with 80–95% support.

stories.title: POPs Regulation Consultation Response Published
stories.summary: DEFRA has published the government's summary of responses and final response to its consultation on amendments to the Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) Regulation 2026, setting out how the rules on hazardous chemicals will be updated.

stories.title: Defence Personnel Health and Safety Statistics 2025/26 Published
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence published its annual health and safety statistics covering injury, illness and deaths of UK regular armed forces personnel and MoD civilian employees recorded in 2025/26.

stories.title: MoD Linton-on-Ouse Site Considered for Asylum Accommodation
stories.summary: The former MoD base at Linton-on-Ouse in North Yorkshire — no longer in active military use — is being considered by the UK government as a potential site for accommodating asylum seekers, according to an updated Home Office factsheet.

stories.title: Updated Guidance on Agreement on Defence Export Controls
stories.summary: The MoD has updated guidance on how to submit export licence applications under the Agreement on Defence Export Controls, following the UK's accession to this agreement in December 2025, which aims to reduce the administrative burden for defence-related exports.

stories.title: BIST Refers £350m Critical Chemicals Resilience Fund to CMA for Review
stories.summary: BIST has referred its proposed Critical Chemicals Resilience Fund (CCRF) — a £350m subsidy scheme to support strategically important UK chemical producers through March 2030 — to the CMA's Subsidy Advice Unit for independent review of its compliance with subsidy control rules. The scheme targets chemicals critical to national infrastructure and key supply chains.

stories.title: Local Full Fibre Networks Evaluation Reports Published
stories.summary: DSIT (being absorbed into BIST) published two evaluation reports on the Local Full Fibre Networks programme today, examining connectivity outcomes and the broader economic and social impacts of government-funded fibre infrastructure rollout.

stories.title: UK Datacentres to Create Just 25% of Jobs Predicted by Tech Sector
stories.summary: Analysis published by The Guardian finds that the UK's AI datacentre expansion will create far fewer jobs than the tech industry has claimed — just 25% of predicted figures — raising questions about the industrial strategy case being made for the sector's rapid expansion.

stories.title: NHS Reports Busiest Ever Summer: 7.3m A&E Attendances as Heatwaves Drive Record Demand
stories.summary: NHS England's latest performance data shows a record 7.3 million A&E attendances in June, July and August 2026 — 240,000 more than the same period last year — driven by five heatwaves. Health Secretary Yvette Cooper announced £1.5bn to expand hospital capacity and acknowledged that extreme demand is 'no longer confined to winter'. The NHS waiting list in England rose to 7.3 million in July.

stories.title: National Commission on AI in Healthcare Publishes Regulatory Framework Recommendations
stories.summary: The National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare published its report today, setting out recommendations for safely and responsibly adopting AI across health and care. NHS Resolution simultaneously published guidance on indemnity and liability considerations for NHS organisations using AI-enabled technologies.

stories.title: NHS Trusts Publish Statements on Future of Federated Data Platform
stories.summary: Multiple NHS trusts — including Royal Cornwall Hospitals and South West London ICB — published statements addressing the national NHS England Federated Data Platform (FDP) and what its future means for patient data governance and local health services.
